note: D10 cap via 0x50 recursion. Depth 1 (0xff marker). Each 0x40 pushes t (+1) and each 0x50 pops t and inserts a type-2 marker (net +1): after k calls depth = 1 + k. The next push happens at depth 1 + k; at k = 999 it is a push at depth 1000 -> 'Stack overflow (1000 slots)', nothing written. 0x50's insert peaks at depth 999. top = the last type-2 marker, value = PC after f's 0x50 n byte (label 'ret', file offset).
